notes.title: The official version is now on sale! Use Word and PPT to solve puzzles?
notes.content:
Developed by Hello World Studio and published by OKJOY, the 2D platform puzzle game "Hello World" is now officially available on Steam!!!

The original price of the game is 2.99$, but for the first two weeks, it is available at a 10% discount for 2.69$. The estimated gameplay time is around 2-3 hours.

Are you both familiar and unfamiliar with office software like Word, PPT, and Excel? During his university years while preparing his graduation project, the developer had a burst of inspiration based on the operations of various office software. Using a game engine, he transformed these dull and monotonous computer applications into a creative and imaginative puzzle game. In this game, players are led by a cursor sprite to explore and navigate within office software. Players will engage in a series of fun interactions with elements such as folders, junk files, Word documents, PPT slides, Excel sheets, and even binary 0 and 1.

The game also contains many hidden pieces of computer knowledge and Easter eggs. Observe carefully and find them in the game! Don't wait any longer, start your journey now!

Click the link below to purchase the game or add it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802140/Hello_World/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878524/6ca3285974380c313a97da1614b08638f639f2de.png[/img]

notes.title: Reverse Delay: The platform puzzle game "Hello World" is launching on July 12!
notes.content:
[b]"Hello World" is About to be Released![/b]
Developed by Hello World Studio and published by OKJOY, the 2D platform puzzle game "Hello World" will officially launch ahead of schedule on July 12, 2024. Originally priced at 2.99$, it will be available at a discounted price of only 2.69$ for the first two weeks. You can search for it on Steam to download the free demo or add it to your wishlist.

[b]Game Introduction:[/b]
"Hello World" is a 2D platform puzzle game where players take on the role of a student who accidentally enters the computer world. Accompanied by a cursor sprite, they explore various office software. Each level features cleverly designed and entertaining ways to progress, as players find hidden options within the scenes, interact with different elements, and solve problems within the computer to return to the real world.

notes.title: The imaginative platformer "Hello World" has launched its free prologue!
notes.content:
"Hello World" is a 2D platformer puzzle game where players take on the role of a student who accidentally enters the computer world. Accompanied by a cursor sprite, they explore office software. Each level features cleverly designed ways to progress, requiring players to find hidden options in the scenes and interact with various elements to solve problems and return to the real world.

The game is now available for free trial on the Steam prologue page. Interested players can download and experience it.

Differences between the prologue and the full version:

The prologue includes only chapter 1.
The full version will have 5 complete chapters.

"Hello World" Steam Store Page Link：

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2939880/Hello_World/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878524/66ff5e0b59e81aac90d3bbb2ba87338a869cfe83.png[/img]

[b]Game Background[/b]
Have you accidentally entered the computer world? Work with the cursor sprite to complete tasks and find a way to escape! Players will interact with various elements such as folders, trash files, Word , PPT, Excel, and even the binary 0s and 1s in the computer's core. Don't delay—start your journey now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878524/3cbe5e57f47362bed902691300000114a0a3f288.gif[/img]

[b]Roaming in the world of computers.[/b]
Seamlessly switch between running, jumping, and sprinting, using your skills to navigate to the desired locations on the map and explore uncharted territories. Be cautious of the constantly moving binary enemies 0s and 1s at the core level—make sure to steer clear of them!
 
[b]Solve puzzles within scenes to clear levels.[/b]
Utilize computer features and functions, such as controlling folder sizes, to overcome impassable obstacles and pave the way forward; wield a bow and arrow as a weapon to illuminate the darkness and move towards the target.
 
[b]Innovative and engaging game settings.[/b]
After inadvertently entering the world of computers, players will navigate through folders, Word documents, PPT presentations, and Excel sheets. The full version of the game consists of 5 chapters, and successfully completing each chapter will allow players to return to the real world.
During the adventure, players will encounter obstacles such as junk files, antivirus software, and binary 0s and 1s. They must put their thinking caps on to overcome these challenges and escape from the computer.

[h3]Folders[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878524/d878ef97b0ad46a37a68cf1eded39ecaba9cfea7.gif[/img]
Here, within the folder, try altering the folder size to enter the Word document~

[h3]Word[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878524/0ab4e8ce7b3ef62c7282c7696f57a8b0c64732e2.gif[/img]
Finally, you've arrived at the Word. Are they the binary 0s and 1s at the core of the computer?

[h3]PPT[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878524/0fb4cc3f1193cbbcf681b644df72578f12f8b2e3.gif[/img]
This must be the PPT. The familiar animation effects are quite noticeable.

[h3]Excel[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878524/087f6664e98c35e06fcc524fd8755cd67a9ef85b.gif[/img]
Excel? Sounds intriguing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878524/3a898c2204698f15e9c050f6d46d169405c2876b.gif[/img]
This isn't your ordinary brick-breaking game...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878524/a0bdaf0e836bc0328be3b59f993163057525826d.gif[/img]
